fields.contract: SqlDatabases : DatabasesBase<SqlDbConnectionOptions> is the library facade for configured, non-sharded SQL Server database connections. It exposes two constructors: (1) a public constructor SqlDatabases(IOptions<SqlDbConnectionOptions> configOptions, IOptions<SqlGlobalPropertiesOptions>? globalOptions, ILogger<SqlDatabases>? logger) that delegates to the protected constructor with a new SqlClient DataProviderServiceFactory (new DataProviderServiceFactory()), and (2) a protected constructor protected SqlDatabases(IOptions<SqlDbConnectionOptions> configOptions, IDataProviderServiceFactory services, IOptions<SqlGlobalPropertiesOptions>? globalOptions, ILogger<SqlDatabases>? logger) that forwards the caller-supplied IDataProviderServiceFactory and globalOptions?.Value to DatabasesBase<SqlDbConnectionOptions> for derived classes and test doubles.
